premise: Duckling wonders what he is good at; nibbling like Squirrel and munching like Caterpillar don't suit him, until Frog calls him into the pond and he floats.
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: nobody is unkind and nobody has to grow into a swan; he finds his place by finding the water.
lesson: Everyone is good at something of their own.
learning: Ducklings can swim from their very first days

en-US.title: Duckling Finds the Water
en-US.text: {duckling:enter} {duckling:pulse} Little Duckling had fluffy yellow feathers, two orange feet, and one big question. [curious] What am I good at? He waddled over to {squirrel:enter} Squirrel, who was sitting in the grass. {squirrel:live} She nibbled her hazelnut, looked left and right, hid it behind her back… and hugged it. Duckling tried to nibble a nut. {duckling:face sad} {duckling:wobble} Tock! Too hard for a beak. Then he waddled to {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar, who was munching a leaf, {caterpillar:pulse} munch, munch. Duckling tried a nibble. {duckling:face surprised} {duckling:shake} Bleh! Too green. {duckling:face sad} [sighs] Nothing fits, he said. Just then {frog:enter} Frog {frog:hop} called from the pond: Come and splash! Duckling waddled to the edge, one step, two steps… {sfx:splash solo} In he went! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] He floated! His orange feet paddled all by themselves, {duckling:float loop 0.3} paddle, paddle. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} [happily] {sfx:quack} Quack! said Duckling. And Squirrel and Caterpillar {squirrel:hearts} {caterpillar:hearts} cheered from the grass.

es-ES.title: Patito encuentra el agua
es-ES.text: {duckling:enter} {duckling:pulse} El pequeño Patito tenía las plumas amarillas y esponjosas, dos patas naranjas y una gran pregunta. [curious] ¿Para qué soy bueno yo? Se fue anadeando hasta {squirrel:enter} Ardilla, que estaba sentada en la hierba. {squirrel:live} Mordisqueó su avellana, miró a un lado y a otro, la escondió detrás de la espalda… y la abrazó. Patito intentó mordisquear una avellana. {duckling:face sad} {duckling:wobble} ¡Toc! Demasiado dura para un pico. Luego fue anadeando hasta {caterpillar:enter} Oruga, que se estaba comiendo una hoja, {caterpillar:pulse} ñam, ñam. Patito probó un mordisquito. {duckling:face surprised} {duckling:shake} ¡Puaj! Demasiado verde. {duckling:face sad} [sighs] No me sale nada, dijo. Justo entonces {frog:enter} Rana {frog:hop} lo llamó desde la charca: ¡Ven a chapotear! Patito anadeó hasta la orilla, un paso, dos pasos… {sfx:splash solo} ¡Y adentro! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Flotaba! Sus patas naranjas remaban solas, {duckling:float loop 0.3} chof, chof. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} [happily] {sfx:quack} ¡Cuac!, dijo Patito. Y Ardilla y Oruga {squirrel:hearts} {caterpillar:hearts} lo aplaudieron desde la hierba.
